title: Kiritani Haruka — Reality Hits Hard〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm done with all my homework that's due tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I finished quicker than expected.
I'll check our inbox for any possible offers and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Mr. Hiiragi...
He saw the message I sent.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. He says he'll set aside some time to meet with me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which is really kind of him since he's probably unbelievably busy...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Thank you very much for agreeing to meet with me on such short notice.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Okay, I've arranged to meet with him.
If he does happen to know anything about what's happened to us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't get my hopes up.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi may be an industry insider with a lot of connections, but there's no guarantee that he knows anything about our situation.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I should do as much research as I can before our meeting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Furukawa. Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Rumi
rows.Line:
Oh, stop it. Call me Rumi.
I mean, we basically debuted at the same time, and I got my big break while working with ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You haven't changed one bit.
Anyway, Furukawa—I mean, Rumi—it was your humor and witty commentary that made you a star.

rows.Speaker: Rumi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're one of the few people who are willing to sing my praises like that, Haruka. Anyway, what's up? How can I help you today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, I'm looking to expand my current group's footprint, but I'd like to know what the industry thinks of us at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You always knew a lot about what goes on behind the scenes, Rumi, so I was wondering if you knew about any rumors surrounding us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sazana. Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Sazana
rows.Line: Haruka! It's been ages!

rows.Speaker: Sazana
rows.Line: We used to appear on music programs all the time when you were still with ASRUN, but we hardly ever see each other anymore. How's your new group? Are you having fun?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, a lot. We've finally sort of gotten on our feet, so we're looking to expand our footprint.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But something has been bothering us a little...
Would you mind if I asked you a quick question?
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No luck again today...)

rows.Speaker: Rumi
rows.Line:
Rumors about your group?
Oh, I heard about how you saved Mr. Arimura's show! I watched your episode, and loved how driven Minori was!

rows.Speaker: Sazana
rows.Line:
Strange rumors? No, I haven't heard any...
I mean, there's so much gossip flying around that you really don't know what's true and what's not. I wouldn't worry too much if I were you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They haven't heard anything, and they're some of the most recognizable faces in show business...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish we could know whether we're on a wild goose chase.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, you're back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Perfect timing!
There's something you need to see!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Starting with... Ta-daa!
A detailed summary of that online show we're gonna be on!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you even made a list of guests who previously appeared on this program? And you even made note of how they showcased each artist.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It still isn't completely finished, but Minori worked extra hard and gathered all the info we needed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we're here, Airi, let's also have her look at our stream proposals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're also still working on these, but... Here you are. These are our ideas at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. The skincare stream is yours, right, Shizuku? And this cooking stream must be yours, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I see nothing particularly wrong with these proposals. Both should be fun for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You think so? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, what do you think?
Do you feel comfortable with delegating stuff to us now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I always knew that you'd do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Despite their workloads increasing while I'm occupied, they all seem to know exactly what to do.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to keep investigating what's been going on thoroughly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're counting on me, so I need to see this through until I find a satisfactory answer.)
